subject: Q4 Renewal: Roadmap + Demo — scheduling options
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@haloresources.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Q4 Renewal: Roadmap + Demo — scheduling options

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time last week. As we discussed, we'd like to book the Renewal QBR + roadmap demo for Halo Resources to:

- surface the product roadmap items relevant to your security/compliance needs
- run a focused technical demo on our Dedicated + Private deployment options
- agree next-step milestones for the renewal and SOW

Options that work on our side (PST):
1) Single 90-minute session (exec + tech deep-dive) — recommended if Halo prefers a one-hour-and-change deep sync
2) Two 45-minute sessions (exec overview + technical breakout) — splits exec/technical audiences
3) Three 30-minute micro-sessions (targeted stakeholders per session) — good for tightly packed calendars / reduced meeting fatigue

I've attached a short runbook and the updated roadmap deck for reference. If option 3 looks best, we can deliver the same slides in modular segments and tuck follow-ups into async notes.

Proposed tentative dates: Nov 9–11 window. Can you share which option your execs prefer and any blackout times?

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: QBR_Runbook_split-sessions.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Elena Morris <elena@haloresources.com>

Subject: Re: Q4 Renewal: Roadmap + Demo — scheduling options

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the options and the deck. Our execs are swamped the week of Nov 9 — they asked specifically to avoid long blocks. We're leaning strongly toward option 3 (three 30-minute sessions) to reduce fatigue and make it easier to get the right people in for each segment. A couple of constraints:

- Prefer no more than two sessions on the same day for the executive participants.
- One session should be a technical working session with our SRE and infra leads (they prefer later in the day CST).
- Procurement wants a short slot to run through contract timelines and the SOW (15–20 min is fine).

Can you propose three focused agendas (exec summary, technical deep-dive, procurement/next steps) and suggest times in EST/CST/PST? Also confirm if you can provide a single recording + short highlight notes for each micro-session.

Appreciate it,
Elena Morris
Director of Cloud Platforms | Halo Resources
procurement@haloresources.com

Laura / Ben — forwarding Elena's note. Procurement and execs prefer option 3 (three 30-min micro-sessions) to reduce meeting fatigue. They want:

- Session A: Exec summary & renewal commercial framing (30m) — target participants: CEO/VP Product/Head of Cloud.
- Session B: Technical deep-dive (30m) — SRE, infra, security (prefer later CST slot).
- Session C: Procurement & SOW next steps (20–30m) — procurement + legal optional.

Requests / constraints:
- Avoid stacking more than two sessions on a single exec day.
- Deliver one recording per session + a 3-slide highlight summary for asynchronous stakeholders.

Suggested times (convert to client's CST/Eastern preference):
- Option set 1 (spread across two days):
  * Day 1: 09:30–10:00 CST — Exec summary (Aditya + Laura)
  * Day 2: 15:00–15:30 CST — Technical deep-dive (Ben + Priyom)
  * Day 2: 16:00–16:20 CST — Procurement slot (Aditya + Legal)

I attached a split-session runbook template — please review and flag any missing owners. If you agree, I'll:
- Lock tentative calendar invites and assign session owners
- Build the three-slide highlight templates to send to Elena ahead of the session
- Record each session + publish highlight notes to the shared Drive link

Quick asks:
- Ben: can you own the technical runbook and primary demo deck slice?
- Laura: can you co-lead the exec summary with me?
- Priyom: please draft the recording/highlight note template.

Thanks — want to get invites locked today if possible.

Aditya
